head: codex/5558-v1-route-corrective
title: [v0.91.8][WP-20][csdlc-v2] Finish sunset v1 route removal
body:
Closes #5558

## Summary
- Removes the remaining sunset v1 lifecycle wrappers, live callers, obsolete workflow, and active guidance.
- Deletes 2,000 lines of orphaned prompt-editor Rust modules left after their parent module was retired.
- Removes the retired child-module coverage and PR-fast mappings so changed-source gates cannot route dead source into zero-match tests.

## Validation
- `bash adl/tools/test_check_coverage_impact.sh`: PASS for the orphan-removal change.
- `bash adl/tools/test_run_pr_fast_test_lane.sh`: PASS.
- `bash adl/tools/test_csdlc_prompt_editor.sh`: PASS.
- `git diff --check`: PASS.
- `csdlc-doctor --repo . --issue 5558`: PASS in reviewed phase.

## Review
- Independent exact-head review APPROVED substantive commit `4c77a1968bf71d310ccf37c6b340ec00eeb69da6` with no actionable findings.
- Commit `058d7eb97` contains only typed review/lifecycle projection updates over the reviewed implementation.
